title: We very much enjoyed our...
text: We very much enjoyed our tour! Jesus was very informative. The Alcazar was beautiful inside. We got to see just enough of it without it being too much.
author: Jane_M

title: Super "private" tour
text:
We had booked a guide in French for 3 for the visit of the alcazar. The surprise is that we had Jesus, great guide in French for us alone.
Excellent experience between story and humor.
Bravo to Jesus
author: fredolo1313

title: Rachel - the best guide.
text:
We toured Real Alcázar today with a tour guide called Rachel who was a born & bred in Sevilla.
She was excellent. Her history was great & she had such a sense of humour which kept us interested in the your. I would highly recommend this amazing lady.
author: gillian g

title: I recommend it
text: Saverio was very nice and also explained anecdotes which made the visit more interesting. Absolutely recommended
author: theslayer83

title: We loved it! Great guide and spectacular Alcázar. Highly recommended
text: We loved it! The guide knew a lot about the Alcázar but at the same time he avoided giving us an excess of information, he dispensed it well throughout the visit and mixed general information about the Alcázar and each room with anecdotes that made the visit very interesting and enjoyable. We were only two people on the tour and he answered all the questions we had. The tour, together with the fact that the Alcázar itself is a wonder, made it a great experience. Highly recommended!
author: miguelfrognier

title: A must see in Sevilla
text:
Javier was very informative and had a great sense of humor!
Our group was a little lost in regard to finding the meeting place. He was so patient and made sure we arrived before starting the tour. The other guests on the tour were equally considerate and patient. This is a ‘must see’ site while in Sevilla.
author: Joan_C

title: Connecting the dots between history and culture
text: The guided tour was amazing. We learned so much in an entertaining and comprehensive way about history, culture, politics and people. The guide was just full of insights and great stories. Wonderful experience.
author: Bettina_T

title: Great tour of Alcazar given by Javier!
text: Javier is a great tour guide. I got lucky in that there was only me and another English speaking tourist on our tour. She needed to get around using a walker and Javier was super patient and helpful with her. He is very knowledgeable and engaging and made learning about the history of Alcazar fun. I would recommend this tour and to ask for Javier.
author: Stephanie_W

title: Real Alcázar
text: Our guide was very knowledgeable.  He was engaging and passionate about the history behind the Real Alcazar.   I would highly recommend.
author: O2980ICjillc

text: The guided trip to Alcazar was great !! The guide was entertaining and funny (sorry forgot his name)
